title: What are the rates for international calls and SMS from my plan?
content:
Question: What are the rates for international calls and SMS from my plan?

Answer: Standard International Long Distance (ISD) rates apply per destination country unless you have an ISD pack. Check Rates > International under the app for current per-minute and per-SMS rates, or activate a country-specific ISD pack for discounted rates.

Topic: International Calling & SMS
